description: This file defines REST API endpoints for managing stock entries in a dealer management system, including listing, creation, updating, and deletion of stock entries. It uses FastAPI and SQLAlchemy ORM to handle HTTP requests and database operations.

methods.name: Decimal _q2(value: Decimal)
methods.description: Quantizes a Decimal to 2 decimal places to match database scale.

methods.name: Decimal _compute_total_cost(unit_cost: Decimal, quantity: Decimal)
methods.description: Calculates total cost as unit_cost multiplied by quantity, quantized to 2 decimal places.

methods.name: StockEntryOut _to_out(entry: StockEntry)
methods.description: Maps ORM StockEntry model to API response schema StockEntryOut.

methods.name: List[StockEntry] list_stock_entries( dealer_id: int | None = Query( None, description="Optional dealer id to filter stock entries", ), limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200, description="Max number of stock entries to return"), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Number of stock entries to skip"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list stock entries with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: StockEntry create_stock_entry(payload: StockEntryCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new stock entry.

methods.name: StockEntry update_stock_entry( stock_id: int, payload: StockEntryCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing stock entry.

methods.name: None delete_stock_entry(stock_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a stock entry.
